property.confidentiality.message.title: Message confidentiality
property.confidentiality.message.definition: Message content is not disclosed to parties outside the explicitly identified recipient set.
assumptions: The protected information and intended recipients are explicitly identified for the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not prescribe a protocol, algorithm, key size, storage product, or recipient policy.

property.integrity.message.title: Message integrity
property.integrity.message.definition: A receiver can detect unauthorized modification, insertion, deletion, or truncation of protected message content.
assumptions: The protected object and the state transition in which it is interpreted are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not establish origin authentication, availability, or correctness of the protected content.

property.authentication.peer.title: Peer authentication
property.authentication.peer.definition: A party can establish that the communicating peer has the intended scoped identity.
assumptions: The asserted identity type, relying party, and authentication direction are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property does not grant authorization, approval, non-repudiation, or trust outside its scoped context.

property.binding.identity.title: Identity binding
property.binding.identity.definition: The asserted identity is unambiguously bound to the communication context in which it is relied upon.
assumptions: Every value being bound has an unambiguous representation and lifecycle within the evaluated context.
exclusions: This property does not define the encoding, protocol transcript, identity system, or session mechanism.

property.replay-ordering.replay-duplicat.title: Replay and duplicate resistance
property.replay-ordering.replay-duplicat.definition: Previously accepted or duplicated protected input is not silently accepted as a new authorized event.
assumptions: The receiver has an explicit state model for recognizing accepted message instances and transitions.
exclusions: This property does not require a particular counter, clock, window, transport, or persistence mechanism.

property.randomness.nonce-uniqueness.title: Nonce uniqueness
property.randomness.nonce-uniqueness.definition: Values required to be unique are not reused within their explicitly defined key and context scope.
assumptions: The required uniqueness or unpredictability scope is explicitly defined for each generated value.
exclusions: This property does not select a random generator, nonce construction, probability bound, or algorithm.

property.key-management.derivation-conte.title: Key-derivation context binding
property.key-management.derivation-conte.definition: Derived key material is bound to its explicitly identified purpose, parties, context, and version.
assumptions: Key material, metadata, authorized use, and lifecycle authority are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not select a cryptographic primitive, key length, cryptoperiod, or custody product.

property.downgrade-agility.downgrade.title: Downgrade resistance
property.downgrade-agility.downgrade.definition: An attacker cannot cause silent selection of a less protective option outside the authenticated policy and context.
assumptions: Negotiated or configured choices and their authenticated context are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not approve any algorithm or require a specific negotiation mechanism.

property.compromise-recovery.scope.title: Compromise-scope explicitness
property.compromise-recovery.scope.definition: The effects of compromised long-term, session, ephemeral, or derived secret material are bounded and documented by material type and time window.
assumptions: The compromised material, affected period, parties, and recovery event are explicitly scoped.
exclusions: This property is not universal and does not claim protection outside the stated compromise window.

property.metadata-privacy.communication-.title: Communication-metadata privacy
property.metadata-privacy.communication-.definition: Scoped identities, relationships, routing context, and communication attributes are not disclosed beyond the stated observer model.
assumptions: Observable fields and the observer capability under evaluation are explicitly identified.
exclusions: This property does not claim that all traffic characteristics or external observations are hidden.

property.resilience.fail-closed.title: Fail-closed behavior
property.resilience.fail-closed.definition: Invalid, unauthenticated, ambiguous, or unsupported security input cannot silently produce an authorized success state.
assumptions: The permitted failure mode and the state from which recovery is evaluated are explicitly defined.
exclusions: This property does not set a service-level objective or guarantee recovery from every failure.

property.evidence-publication.classifica.title: Evidence-publication classification boundary
property.evidence-publication.classifica.definition: Publication preserves an explicit distinction among public-safe, private, and prohibited material and requires human publication authority.
assumptions: Evidence classification and publication authority are assigned before material is exposed.
exclusions: This property does not authorize publication, disclosure, risk acceptance, or release.
